celeste: Celeste Classic's sprite sheet, font, sound effects and songs, Maddy Thorson and Noel Berry (Celeste Classic); ported to C by lemon32767 (ccleste). no licence published upstream (Celeste Classic is free to play; ccleste's repository carries none). https://github.com/lemon32767/ccleste
    Changes: sound effects taken by ccleste from JeffRuLz's Celeste-Classic-GBA (maxmod_data); songs converted by ccleste from the PICO-8 .wav dumps
